title: 第9章 无力感
novel_title: 手握旧日权柄，弹幕硬说我是主角(灰烬暗燃)
content_zh: 面具人离开后，许牧拿起手机看了一眼时间，发现已经凌晨4:20。平静美好的睡眠时间就这样没了……他因时常担任学生和兼职工双重职业，睡眠时间总是被压榨，所以除了第一喜欢金钱以外，第二个喜欢的就是睡觉。许牧惋惜地摇了摇头，他现在既有困意但又不强烈，即使回去重睡，也会因为脑袋里乱窜的思绪久久无法入眠。让他欣慰的是，虽然付出了睡眠时间的代价，但也换来了不错的收获。还不到6个小时，就掌握了普通人成为超凡者的三种办法，还顺带获得了更多超凡知识。比如存在带有特殊功能的超凡物品和符咒；比如超凡生物死亡后，超凡灵性的凝聚或逸散规律。至于物质收获……许牧从裤子口袋里掏出那三枚符咒，把它们放于茶几上的那沓钞票旁边。他身体前倾，右手拿起那沓钞票，把它向上抛起，再稳稳接住，无意识地重复着这个动作，思绪早已飞远。这支付手段略显复古呀，喜欢使用现金，弄得跟电影里的黑帮交易一样……许牧一时对面具人所在的组织产生了一点好奇。从面具人的行事风格来看，他不像是那种带着极大恶意的人，他们的组织更是以收纳帮助遭遇苦难之人为理念。目前来看应该是中立偏友好的组织。如果面具人说的都是真的，如果我不需要去749混讨论度，可能真有兴趣深入了解一下。可惜没如果……许牧又一次接住落下的钞票，重新放置于茶几上。他现在不得不严肃正视一个问题：肖凡以及和他有关的那些失控者。假如李桃潜意识里的演唱会画面是根据真实经历具现出来的，那青藤市此刻正在面临着一个巨大的威胁。正常来说，他无需担心什么，反正他在青藤市举目无亲，无牵无挂，自已还是超凡者，有一定的自保能力。但姑姑一家今天会来青藤市，而且妹妹也要在青藤大学读书。结合安琳、李桃的年龄段，许牧认为在青藤大学里，有很大概率隐藏着那种失控的怪物。只需要一次爆发，青藤大学里就会上演一场血腥至极的惨剧。而妹妹同为女生，万一和那种怪物分到同一栋宿舍楼，那就更危险了。绝不能让那种事情发生。许牧不敢继续想象之后的画面，指尖轻敲茶几表面，他立刻思考起对策：今天是8月21号，距离青藤大学开学时间还有9天，争取在9天时间内解决肖凡延伸出来的危机。面具人背后的组织最近正在狩猎那些失控者，这是个好事，希望他们能加派人手，搞快一点。而自已这边也不能闲着，今天就得把情况通知给陆剑星他们，希望他们能够重视。想到这里，许牧忽然涌现出一股无力感：要是自已足够强大，足以保护妹妹，就不用寄希望于别人了。得尽快了解超凡序列和对应的超凡灵性获取渠道了，等今天和姑姑一家见完面后，马上联系殡仪馆主陈丧，加入749！749内部应该就有对应的超凡知识，而且质量和真实性也能得到保证。做好了打算，许牧收拾了一下，将脸上和手上已经干涸的血渍清洗一番，又找出新床单，把那张沾血的换掉。想到今天的事情不少，觉得有必要补充好体力，即使不怎么困，他也强迫自已补个觉。上午10点30，阳光透过窗户洒进来，给卧室蒙上一层金色纱幔，补眠了几个小时的许牧被温暖的光线照醒。他伸着懒腰坐起目光投向窗外，白云蓝天，晴空万里，微风和煦，是个不错的天气。许牧的心情也跟着变得不错，昨晚连续经历了两次凶险诡异的超凡事件，今天再看见这幅宁静祥和的景色，颇有种探险归来后的安全放松感。嗡~嗡~手机适时震动了两下，许牧拿起来查看，发现是姑姑发来的消息。‘姑姑：小牧，我们到青藤了，来这里，姑姑请你吃饭。’一个地图位置紧跟着发了过来，地点是一家叫‘飞鸟与鱼’的餐厅。‘许牧：好，我很快就过去。’回完消息，许牧翻身下床，快速洗漱，换了一套干净的衣服。穿衣镜里映照出挺拔的身影和清朗的脸庞，他反复检视自已几遍，确认成为超凡者后身体没什么异常变化，才放心出门赴约。他一边下楼，一边给陈丧发去消息，告诉对方自已已经同意加入749，成为外勤人员，并且今天下午就可以“入职”。同时，他把关于肖凡派对的娱乐新闻转发给陈丧，特意备注：“怀疑和安琳的诡异情况有关，麻烦转发给陆剑星他们。”至于自已在集体潜意识空间的经历，手机里不好讲清楚，他打算下午当面和陆剑星提出。所以此刻只是对陈丧说下午还有重要事情要告知陆剑星。……青藤市，东区，749局。陆剑星手里拿着一份报告，上面是关于安琳近一年的大致行踪轨迹和社交圈层。这份报告由警署连夜调查出具，今天上午10点发到他手机里，被打印了几份出来。“安琳，青藤大学艺术系今年的应届毕业生。”“社交圈层只有同校人员。”“近一年没离开过青藤市，9个月前开始追星肖凡，目前为止参加过两次肖凡的线下活动。”“分别是今年2月14号的演唱会和5月21号的粉丝见面会。除以上两次较为明显的活动轨迹，正常情况都待在实习单位。”陆剑星挑重点信息默读了一遍。在他座位旁，拿着同样的报告单的风华瑾看完后抬起脑袋。“有什么看法？”陆剑星侧头问道。风华瑾嗯了一声，抿了抿唇分析道：“结合安宏福对神秘面具人的话语总结，安琳的死亡和社会高阶层的人有关。假设神秘人没有欺骗安宏福，再结合安琳的社交圈层，符合高阶层的人物，只有肖凡。”听完她的分析，陆剑星沉稳点头，同意道：“你的想法和我吻合，而且你看这个……”他掏出手机，点开了陈丧的聊天框。聊天记录里，陈丧提到许牧已经同意成为749外勤，并且下午还有重要事情需要当面告知。消息里还有一则陈丧转发过来的娱乐圈八卦新闻，并备注同样是许牧要求转发过来的。陆剑星点开那则新闻，正是关于肖凡开派对，事后多人肚子出现不适的曝光。风华瑾大致浏览了一下新闻内容道：“看来肖凡大概率存在问题，许牧的关注点很奇特，在事先不知道肖凡有问题的情况下，竟能注意到一则八卦新闻里的线索，未免太敏锐了。”陆剑星收起手机，拿起桌子上的咖啡喝了一口，继而说道：“确实，许牧身上藏着秘密，昨晚凌晨4点，他的阴影标记在他家30米范围内移动过，不知在做什么，下午签合同的时候再多试探试探。先休息一下，下午和他对接完，就着手调查肖凡。”“好，那我去买午饭，想吃什么，我帮你带回来。”“我和你一起去。”
content_en: After the masked man left, Xu Mu picked up his phone and looked at the time and found that it was already 4:20 in the morning.The peaceful and beautiful sleep time is gone... Because he often works as a student and a part-time worker, his sleep time is always squeezed, so besides money, his second favorite is sleeping.Xu Mu shook his head regretfully. He was sleepy now but not too much. Even if he went back to sleep, he would be unable to fall asleep for a long time because of the thoughts running around in his head.What pleased him was that although he paid the price of sleep time, he also gained good rewards.In less than 6 hours, he has mastered three ways for ordinary people to become extraordinary, and he has also acquired more extraordinary knowledge.For example, there are extraordinary items and spells with special functions; for example, after the death of extraordinary creatures, the rules of the concentration or dissipation of extraordinary spirituality.As for material gains... Xu Mu took out the three charms from his pants pocket and placed them next to the stack of banknotes on the coffee table.He leaned forward, picked up the wad of banknotes with his right hand, threw it up, and then caught it firmly, repeating this action unconsciously, his thoughts already flying far away.This method of payment is a bit retro, and it likes to use cash, making it look like gangster transactions in movies... Xu Mu was temporarily curious about the organization where the masked man belonged.Judging from the masked man's behavior, he does not seem to be the kind of person with great malice. Their organization is based on the concept of accepting and helping people who are in trouble.At present, it seems to be a neutral and friendly organization.If what the masked man said is true, and if I don’t need to go to 749 to discuss it, I might be really interested in learning more about it.What a pity... Xu Mu caught the falling banknotes again and placed them again on the coffee table.He now had to face up to a problem seriously: Xiao Fan and the out-of-control people related to him.If the concert scene in Li Tao's subconscious is based on real experience, then Qingteng City is facing a huge threat at this moment.Normally, he doesn't have anything to worry about. Anyway, he has no relatives and no worries in Ivy City. He is still an extraordinary person and has a certain ability to protect himself.But my aunt's family will come to Qingteng City today, and my sister also wants to study at Qingteng University.Considering the age groups of An Lin and Li Tao, Xu Mu believed that there was a high probability that there was a monster hiding out of control in Ivy League University.All it takes is one outbreak, and a bloody tragedy will take place in Ivy League University.As for my younger sister, who is also a girl, it would be even more dangerous if she were assigned to the same dormitory building as that kind of monster.Never let that happen.Xu Mu did not dare to continue imagining what would happen next. He tapped his fingertips on the surface of the coffee table and immediately thought of a countermeasure: Today is August 21st, and there are still 9 days before the start of the Ivy League University. Try to resolve the crisis that Xiao Fan has extended within 9 days.The organization behind the masked man is hunting those who are out of control recently, which is a good thing. I hope they can send more manpower to do it faster.And I can't be idle here. I have to inform Lu Jianxing and others of the situation today, hoping that they will take it seriously.Thinking of this, Xu Mu suddenly felt a sense of powerlessness: If he was strong enough to protect his sister, there would be no need to place hope on others.It is necessary to understand the extraordinary sequence and the corresponding extraordinary spiritual acquisition channels as soon as possible. After meeting with my aunt and her family today, I will immediately contact the funeral parlor owner Chen Sang and join 749! There should be corresponding extraordinary knowledge within 749, and the quality and authenticity can be guaranteed.After making a plan, Xu Mu tidied up, washed the dried blood stains on his face and hands, found a new sheet, and replaced the bloody one.Thinking that there were a lot of things going on today, he felt it was necessary to replenish his energy. Even if he wasn't very sleepy, he forced himself to catch up on some sleep.At 10:30 in the morning, the sun streamed in through the window, casting a golden gauze over the bedroom. Xu Mu, who had been sleeping for a few hours, was awakened by the warm light.He stretched and sat up and looked out the window. He saw white clouds, blue sky, clear sky, and gentle breeze. It was a good weather.Xu Mu's mood also became better. He experienced two dangerous and strange extraordinary events last night. Seeing this peaceful and peaceful scenery again today gave him a sense of safety and relaxation after returning from an adventure.Buzz~buzz~ The phone vibrated twice at the right time. Xu Mu picked it up to check and found that it was a message from his aunt.‘Aunt: Xiaomu, we have arrived at Qingteng, come here, aunt will treat you to dinner.’ A map location was sent immediately, and the location was a restaurant called ‘Birds and Fish’.‘Xu Mu: Okay, I’ll be there soon.’ After replying to the message, Xu Mu got out of bed, quickly washed up, and changed into a set of clean clothes.The tall figure and clear face were reflected in the dressing mirror. He checked himself several times and confirmed that there were no abnormal changes in his body after becoming a transcendent, and then he went out for the appointment with confidence.As he went downstairs, he sent a message to Chen Sang, telling him that he had agreed to join 749 as a field staff, and that he could "join" this afternoon.At the same time, he forwarded the entertainment news about Xiao Fan's party to Chen Sang, with a special note: "I suspect it is related to An Lin's strange situation, please forward it to Lu Jianxing and the others." As for his experience in the collective subconscious space, it was difficult to explain clearly on the phone, so he planned to raise it with Lu Jianxing in person in the afternoon.So at this moment, I just told Chen Sang that I had something important to inform Lu Jianxing in the afternoon....Qingteng City, East District, Bureau 749.Lu Jianxing held a report in his hand, which contained An Lin's general whereabouts and social circle in the past year.This report was issued by the police station after an overnight investigation. It was sent to his mobile phone at 10 o'clock this morning and several copies were printed out."An Lin, this year's graduate of the Art Department of Ivy League University." "The social circle is only people from the same school." "I haven't left Ivy League City in the past year. I started chasing the star Xiao Fan 9 months ago. I have participated in two offline activities of Xiao Fan so far." "They were the concert on February 14 this year and the fan meeting on May 21. Except for the above two obvious activity tracks, under normal circumstances, I stayed in the internship unit." Lu Jianxing picked out the key information and read it silently.Next to his seat, Feng Huajin, who was holding the same report sheet, raised his head after reading it."What do you think?" Lu Jianxing asked, turning his head.Feng Huajin hummed, pursed her lips and analyzed: "Based on An Hongfu's summary of the mysterious masked man's words, An Lin's death is related to people from high social classes. Assuming that the mysterious man did not deceive An Hongfu, and combined with An Lin's social circle, the only person who fits the high class is Xiao Fan." After listening to her analysis, Lu Jianxing nodded calmly and agreed: "Your thoughts are consistent with mine, and look at this..." He took out his mobile phone and opened Chen Sang's chat box.In the chat log, Chen Sang mentioned that Xu Mu had agreed to become a 749 field officer and that there were important things that needed to be informed in person in the afternoon.There was also a piece of entertainment industry gossip news forwarded by Chen Sang, with a note that it was also forwarded at the request of Xu Mu.Lu Jianxing clicked on the news, which was about Xiao Fan's party and the revelation that many people had stomach discomfort afterwards.Feng Huajin briefly browsed the news content and said: "It seems that there is a high probability that Xiao Fan has a problem. Xu Mu's focus is very strange. Without knowing in advance that Xiao Fan has a problem, he can notice the clues in a gossip news. It is too sharp." Lu Jianxing put away the phone, picked up the coffee on the table and took a sip, and then said: "Indeed, Xu MuThere is a secret hidden in Mu. At 4 o'clock in the morning last night, his shadow mark moved within 30 meters of his house.I don't know what he was doing. Let's take a rest while signing the contract in the afternoon.After meeting with him in the afternoon, we will start investigating Xiao Fan."Okay, then I will buy lunch. I will bring it back for you."
